SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.instance_id AS instanceId, r.game_id AS gameId, r.user_id AS userId, r.student_id AS studentId, r.result AS result, r.dimension_snapshot AS dimensionSnapshot, r.careers_snapshot AS careersSnapshot, r.shared_order_snapshot AS sharedOrderSnapshot, r.create_time AS createTime, s.student_name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.gender AS gender, COALESCE(s.school_id, ar.school_id) AS schoolId, d.parent_id AS departmentId, s.department_id AS majorId, sc.title AS schoolName, c.title AS departmentName, d.title AS major FROM gkzh_sszctop_student_report r LEFT JOIN gkzh_activity_game ag ON ag.game_id = r.game_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_activity_area ar ON ar.area_id = ag.area_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_student s ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN gkzh_school sc ON sc.school_id = COALESCE(s.school_id, ar.school_id) LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department d ON d.department_id = s.department_id LEFT JOIN gkzh_school_department c ON c.department_id = d.parent_id
ORDER BY r.report_id DESC
